about: The troll's overhead smash, keyed on its own 4 m body (D588, docs/keyed-moves.md), by key.ts's `fists`, put into troll.glb by the build's creature:troll step (bodies.json `keyed`). Two fists, no item: a crouch, both fists raised behind the head and held, a short step out with the left foot and a drop into a squat over both planted feet, the hips kept up (1.15 m) and the trunk pitched level from them, the fists driven into the ground under the shoulders 1.4 m ahead (its arms are 1.15 m, so the fists reach the ground only with the shoulders that low), the head lifted, held there, then a slow rise (troll-blows j3: j2's lunge lay the body down, a belly flop on the workbench sheet). No pose sheet was drawn: keyed from the brief and corrected against stick figures and renders of our own body (troll-blows j2, 2026-11-09). Timing is a GUESS (D654): three searches found no shipped game's slam in frames; it follows research/melee-feel.md (a held wind-up, a fast strike, a long bent recovery) and the one number read, an analyst's Dark Souls 3 rule that signal plus attack is at least 340 ms and an end pose held at least 240 ms (gamedeveloper.com, Anatomy of an enemy attack in Dark Souls 3). Its hips', chest's and head's numbers are from the keyed idle it starts on (troll_idle.json: hunched, the hips pitched 14 and the chest 38 forward of the bind pose), so a pitch of -30 here is the old idle's lean back and an upright trunk about -20 (troll-blows j4: the same poses in the model as j3's, written again from the new start). Metres, degrees, seconds; places are [right, up, forward] from the model's origin.
name: Troll_Smash
